preflight_evidence.historical_stage_one_score_repeatability: Not bit-identical across run roots: same initial ASTs retained the same accuracy_500 and feature dimension, while measured feature runtime differed. These are archival measurements, not a fresh E1 evaluator preflight.
preflight_evidence.official_test_access_assessment: The protocol forbids official-test access, and the search-data object contains train/validation only after loading. However, load_mnist_search_data calls _load_openml_arrays, which fetches all 70,000 rows and checks all pixels before slicing rows 0:60,000. The current evaluator path therefore cannot be certified as avoiding reads of the official test rows.
preflight_evidence.source_evaluator_search_only: MNISTSearchData exposes train and validation arrays only; the V3.2 runner uses ProgramEvaluator with train_sizes=(500,).

run_status: No E1 condition has been launched.

selection_rule.eligibility: Standalone-installable from G0; one Image input; validates through the existing V4 macro validator and expands to G0 operations; expanded node_count <= 11, depth <= 6, feature dimension <= 128; at least 3 distinct scored descendant candidates inherit and use the behavior.
selection_rule.evidence: Only the 216 adaptive proposals with a recorded discovery_fitness in the five preserved V10 seed roots; each candidate was replay-validated against the exact selected prefill lineage_state.json.
selection_rule.macro_identity: MacroPrimitive.sha256 over canonical_json is the canonical definition identity; macro_behavior_hash is the expanded behavior identity. Birth counts, canonical definitions, and behavior groups are reported separately.
selection_rule.ranking: Distinct expanded behavior groups ranked by descending distinct scored descendant candidate count, then ascending expanded node count, ascending depth, then behavior SHA-256. For each selected behavior, use the lexicographically smallest canonical definition SHA-256 among eligible definitions.
selection_rule.selection_scope: Discovery evidence only; no V14 evidence or fresh-search outcomes used.

source_evidence.strict_lineage_replay: 216/216 candidates matched selected parent candidate ID, selected prefill current language hash, parent language lineage, child language hash, child state hash, expanded AST hash, and canonical candidate identity.
